offers_products.reason: Sells insurance policies, which are a financial service rather than goods or software.

offers_services.reason: Specialty insurance underwriting: D&O, cyber, E&O, casualty and healthcare liability coverage; insurers count as services.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Commercial coverage for public companies, private businesses, nonprofits and healthcare organizations, sold through brokers.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Insures businesses, nonprofits, hospitals, public entities and financial institutions via brokers.

recurring_revenue.reason: Insurance policies written and renewed annually produce recurring premium revenue.

cyclical_demand.reason: Liability insurance for D&O, casualty and medical malpractice is largely required or necessary and renews regardless of downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Annual insurance premiums are recurring, routine purchases, not large infrequent purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for risk-bearing capacity and insurance policies backed by capital, not mainly staff time.

large_customers.reason: Clients range from established public companies to growing private businesses and nonprofits; the mix is unclear.

asset_heavy.reason: Underwriting insurer needs capital and reinsurance but not plants, fleets or networks; it is asset-light physically.

notes: Large-customer answer is uncertain because clients span large public companies and smaller private businesses.
